body:
ChannelStatus.unreadable (a list of ROLE NAMES that failed their shapes, T217) and
ForgivenHealth.unreadable (a list of DELTA IDS, slate.ts) share a name and a type, so a swap
type-checks silently. Nothing swaps them today. Rename one — recommendation:
ChannelStatus.unreadable → ChannelStatus.illegibleRoles (the reader-side vocabulary), keeping
ForgivenHealth as is since its name predates. Check every surface string that renders the
field, and note the loam_federate_status JSON key is now API surface for MCP clients — if the
key must stay stable for compatibility, rename only the TypeScript field and keep the wire
key, saying so at the definition.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) The two fields no longer share a name; every consumer compiles and every surface renders
    as before (byte-parity on the three T217 surfaces' output for the same fixture). Verify:
    the existing T217 rails stay green unedited, plus a compile.

Merge tier: chore. Self-merge on green.
title: Rename one of the two `unreadable` fields — roles vs delta ids, both readonly string[]
